Histograms per numeric column

Source: R/EXPLORE_ASSUMPTIONS.R
plot_histogram.Rd

Produces one ggplot histogram per numeric column of df. Each plot caption shows the observation count, mean, SD, and median of the column. A progress bar is printed to the console.

Usage

plot_histogram(
  df,
  bins = 30,
  title = "",
  base_size = 10,
  xlims = NULL,
  fill = "gray25",
  color = "gray50",
  ylab = "Count",
  pb = FALSE
)

Arguments

df

Data frame or numeric vector. Non-numeric columns are silently dropped.

bins

Number of histogram bins passed to geom_histogram. Default is 30.

title

Character string used as the plot title. Default is "".

base_size

Base font size passed to theme_bw(). Default is 10.

xlims

Length-2 numeric vector setting the x-axis limits, e.g. c(0, 50). When NULL (default) limits are determined automatically.

fill

Fill colour of the histogram bars. Default is "gray25".

color

Outline colour of the histogram bars. Default is "gray50".

ylab

Y-axis label. Default is "Count".

pb

Logical; whether to display a progress bar in the console. Default is FALSE.

Value

A named list of ggplot objects, one per numeric column.

Examples

vector <- generate_missing(rnorm(50), missing = 10)
df <- generate_missing(mtcars[, 1:2], missing = 10)
plot_histogram(df = vector)

plot_histogram(df = df, xlims = c(0, 50))


plot_histogram(df = df)


plot_multiplot(plotlist = plot_histogram(df = mtcars[,1:4]), cols = 2)
